implementation: frontend/pages/api/verify-gg-member.ts - retry logic with exponential backoff
workaround.effectiveness: Reduces API calls by ~80%, handles transient failures

known_issues.permanent_solution: Consider Redis caching for multi-instance deployments
known_issues.notes: Current solution sufficient for single-instance deployment

known_issues.title: FAISS index loading on cold start
known_issues.description: FAISS index takes 1-2 seconds to load on backend startup
symptoms: First AI query slower than subsequent ones

workaround.description: Index loaded once at startup and cached in memory
workaround.implementation: backend/main.py - AI initialization in startup event
workaround.effectiveness: After initial load, all queries are fast

known_issues.permanent_solution: Pre-warm index or implement lazy loading with user feedback
known_issues.notes: Only affects first query after restart
